title: matches_recipient test catch-all arm (_ => false) makes future variants silently fail
description: smime_tests.rs lines 119-121: the test implementation of matches_recipient has '_ => false'. RecipientIdentifier is #[non_exhaustive], so this is required to compile. But because the trait is designed for user implementation, this establishes the pattern that 'add a catch-all false arm' is the right way to implement the method. A real implementation that silently fails to match a new variant (e.g. if a third variant is added later) would cause decrypt() to return NoMatchingRecipient with no indication of what went wrong. The doc comment example in key.rs (lines 116-137) correctly shows exhaustive matching. The test implementation contradicts the documented pattern. Either the example should show a #[non_exhaustive]-compatible pattern, or the test should mirror the documented example.
close_reason: Fixed: doc comment for matches_recipient now shows the required catch-all arm with explanation of #[non_exhaustive]
